manifest_meta.purpose: Code map for AI agents. Consult before editing; update in the same change whenever files, features, data flows, modes, preferences, assets, native code, or build config change (see AGENTS.md).
manifest_meta.app_version: 1.2.4 (versionCode 14; per-ABI builds use 14*10+n; release tag v1.2.4)

project.name: Camera
project.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (LICENSE at repo root, verbatim gnu.org text). Dependencies must be GPLv3-compatible (Apache-2.0 OK).
project.distribution_goal: F-Droid. No Google Play Services, no proprietary/telemetry libraries, no network access. Do NOT add com.google.* (other than AndroidX transitive annotations), Firebase, MediaPipe, TensorFlow/LiteRT, ML Kit, OkHttp/Coil, or prebuilt binaries checked into the repo.
project.architecture_pattern: Single-module MVVM: Compose UI -> CameraViewModel (StateFlow) -> CaptureEngine interface (HybridCaptureEngine routing to CameraXProvider / Camera2Provider) + repositories. Manual DI in MainActivity.onCreate (Hilt is NOT wired; core/di/CameraModule.kt is fully commented out).

tech_stack.ui_framework: Jetpack Compose + Material 3, no navigation library; two Activities. Theming in ui/theme/Theme.kt: CameraAppTheme (dynamic Material You colors + system light/dark; fixed fallback palette in previews) and ViewfinderTheme (always dark, dynamic accent) used by MainActivity. Use MaterialTheme.colorScheme / CameraAccent / OnCameraAccent / ControlBackground (composable getters in CameraComponents.kt) instead of hard-coded colors. XML: Theme.Camera (android:Theme.DeviceDefault.DayNight, no action bar) for SettingsActivity; Theme.Camera.Viewfinder (black window, light bar icons) for MainActivity. MainActivity forces SystemBarStyle.dark; SettingsActivity uses auto. No Material Components library.
tech_stack.camera: CameraX 1.3.1 (core, camera2 interop, lifecycle, video, view, extensions) and raw Camera2 for Night/HDR/RAW bursts and high-speed video
tech_stack.vision: OpenCV 4.12.0 from Maven Central (org.opencv:opencv, Apache-2.0) consumed via prefab (OpenCV::opencv_java4). Only symbols exported by libopencv_java4.so are usable: core/imgproc/photo/features2d/calib3d/objdetect (incl. QRCodeDetectorAruco and barcode::BarcodeDetector) etc. The cv::detail stitching internals are NOT exported. Face detection uses the framework android.media.FaceDetector.
tech_stack.gpu: OpenGL ES 3 via EGL14 with GLSL shaders in assets/shaders (pixel binning only)
tech_stack.image_loading: ContentResolver.loadThumbnail (MediaThumbnail composable in MainActivity.kt); no image-loading library
tech_stack.async: Kotlin Coroutines & StateFlow; Camera2 uses a HandlerThread; analyzers use ExecutorServices
tech_stack.build: AGP 8.7.3, compileSdk/targetSdk 35, minSdk 31, version catalog gradle/libs.versions.toml, release R8 minify + shrinkResources enabled (app/proguard-rules.pro keeps NativePanoramaBridge/NativeVisionBridge for JNI), buildConfig + prefab enabled, dependenciesInfo excluded from APK/AAB, optional -PabiFilter=<abi> per-ABI build. Reproducible builds: F-Droid's recipe has Binaries: https://github.com/fearmikey/Camera/releases/download/v%v/Camera-%v-%c.apk + AllowedAPKSigningKeys, so its unsigned APK must be byte-identical to the signed GitHub one. CMakeLists.txt maps the repo root, NDK and OpenCV prefab include dirs out of __FILE__/debug info (-ffile-prefix-map) and links with --build-id=none; do not add path-, time- or machine-dependent build inputs. Release APKs come from scripts/build-release.sh <tag> (fresh clone of the tag, git clean before each ABI, same prebuild sed as the recipe, apksigner v2+v3 with --alignment-preserved; signing settings from the private ~/.config/camera-release/release.env, which agents must never read) -> dist/<tag>/ (gitignored); local incremental builds are NOT reproducible references. The full agent-run release procedure is AGENTS.md > RELEASE WORKFLOW.

data_flow_pattern.description: Unidirectional data flow. UI events call CameraViewModel methods; ViewModel drives CaptureEngine and repositories and emits CameraUiState plus side flows; Compose collects them.

layers.ui: MainActivity.kt (CameraScreen and all main-screen composables, MediaThumbnail) + ui/camera/* overlays + ui/settings/SettingsSheet.kt + SettingsActivity.kt
layers.zoom: CameraViewModel.setZoom = immediate (pinch; cancels a glide). CameraViewModel.animateZoomTo = preset taps (ViewfinderZoomControls) and volume-key zoom: Choreographer-paced coroutine in viewModelScope, log-space interpolation with PathInterpolator(0.4,0,0.2,1), 200ms + 90ms per doubling (max 420ms), sets CameraViewModel.zoomState.target while running; each step goes through applyZoom (clamp -> zoomState.level -> CaptureEngine.setZoom). Live zoom lives in its own StateFlow (zoomState: ZoomUiState(level, target), CameraUiState.kt), not in CameraUiState, so per-frame zoom only recomposes ViewfinderZoomControls (zoomLevel/zoomTarget are () -> providers read there); CameraPreview's pinch handler reads viewModel.zoomState.value directly (current even between frames). toggleCamera cancels it. CameraXProvider remembers the last ratio and re-applies it after a rebind. Limits/presets/starting zoom per mode come from ZoomPolicy.forMode (domain/model/ZoomPolicy.kt, via CameraViewModel.zoomPolicy; clampZoom uses it): Portrait rear = presets 1x/2x, starts at 2x, pinch 1-3x; Portrait front = camera presets, starts at the full view, pinch to a 2.9x label; other modes = camera range/presets, start 1x. onModeZoomChanged glides to the default when entering/leaving Portrait and when entering Panorama (always starts at 1x); toggleCamera sets pendingDefaultZoom, applied in onCameraReady. Labels: ZoomPresets.labelScale gives a wide selfie camera (35mm-equivalent / 24mm <= 0.8, e.g. Pixel ~17mm -> 0.7) a ratio->label factor (CameraHardwareCapabilities/CameraUiState.zoomLabelScale), so its full view reads '.7' and ZoomPresets.compute adds a 1/0.7 preset labeled '1x' (all modes); ZoomSwitcher multiplies labels by it.
layers.viewmodel: ui/camera/CameraViewModel.kt (also a SensorEventListener at SENSOR_DELAY_GAME, registered in onResume and removed in onPause, producing LevelState + orientation + the tap-focus release). Exposes uiState, zoomState, panoramaProgress, levelState, gestureState, orientationState, focusState. Performance rule: per-frame values get their own StateFlow and are read only by the composable that needs them (CameraScreen collects zoomState/panoramaProgress as State without reading .value; ReadInOwnScope / () -> providers / graphicsLayer lambdas defer reads). CameraScreen's gesture/shutter/thumbnail callbacks read viewModel.uiState.value at call time instead of capturing uiState, so they stay stable and CameraPreview/CameraControls can skip recomposition. Capabilities/zoom presets refresh in onCameraReady() (engine callback).
layers.engine: data/engine/CaptureEngine.kt interface -> HybridCaptureEngine.kt routes per CameraMode to CameraXProvider.kt or Camera2Provider.kt
layers.processing: data/engine/processing/* (ImageProcessor facade, GpuImageProcessor binning, NightStacker, PortraitSegmenter, FaceLocator, NativeVisionBridge, NativePanoramaBridge, PanoramaSession, PanoramaFrameAnalyzer)
layers.repository: data/repository/UserPreferencesRepository.kt (DataStore), MediaRepository.kt (latest MediaStore URI + thumbnails), MediaSaver.kt (all processed JPEG writes + MediaStore value builders), DeviceLocationProvider.kt (geotag source)
layers.domain: domain/model/* enums and data classes shared across layers

data_flow_pattern.preferences_flow: UserPreferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow -> CameraViewModel.observePreferences() -> CameraUiState.userPreferences and captureEngine.applySettings(prefs) / setFlashMode(prefs.effectiveFlashMode) / setGestureTriggerEnabled. SettingsActivity writes to the repository directly (no ViewModel).
data_flow_pattern.capture_output: Providers save to MediaStore DCIM/Camera themselves (processed bitmaps via MediaSaver.saveJpeg with IS_PENDING + EXIF/GPS; CameraX file captures via MediaSaver.newPhotoValues/newVideoValues with ImageCapture.Metadata.location) and return a URI string via onSuccess; ViewModel then updates lastCapturedUri / refreshThumbnail().
data_flow_pattern.framing: Photos match the viewfinder. CameraPreview reports the visible viewfinder width/height (onViewfinderAspect, LaunchedEffect on its size) -> CameraViewModel.onViewfinderAspect -> CaptureEngine.setViewfinderAspectRatio (all three engines). FrameGeometry (domain/model/FrameGeometry.kt, pure Kotlin, FrameGeometryTest) holds the maths: photoAspect (4:3 / 16:9 from prefs.aspectRatio; Full = the measured viewfinder, long/short), centerCrop (orientation-preserving center crop), pickSize, viewfinderToSensor. CameraX: only the Full ratio crops (its 4:3 stream is wider than the screen): CameraXProvider.applyCropAspect -> ImageCapture.setCropAspectRatio (Rational in the target rotation's orientation; CameraX swaps it on setTargetRotation; a new ImageCapture per bind starts uncropped) crops file saves; in-memory paths (captureBinnedPhoto, captureUprightBitmap/Portrait) ignore crop rects, so they call cropToViewfinder. Camera2: pickSize(format, maxPixels, aspect = photoAspect(), preferExact) picks the stream with the most pixels after cropping to the viewfinder (Night/Long exposure YUV <= 12.6MP, HDR JPEG <= 8.4MP), then finishBitmap center-crops and mirrors front selfies when prefs.mirrorSelfies; captureStill prefers a JPEG size of exactly that shape (saved as is), else finishJpeg decodes only the visible region (BitmapRegionDecoder), applies the EXIF rotation and re-encodes via MediaSaver (IMG_). The DNG always keeps the full sensor. Tap-to-focus: HybridCaptureEngine.focusAt also calls Camera2Provider.focusAt, which stores the normalized tap (cleared by cancelFocus and camera switches); tapMetering maps it with FrameGeometry.viewfinderToSensor (FILL_CENTER crop, front mirror, sensor orientation, 16:9 stream band; 3A regions are post-zoom so zoom needs no correction) to a 10% MeteringRectangle; warmUp sets AE/AWB regions and, with CONTROL_MAX_REGIONS_AF > 0 and AF_MODE_AUTO, runs one AF_TRIGGER_START scan and waits for FOCUSED/NOT_FOCUSED_LOCKED (+1s timeout); captureStill repeats the regions (AF AUTO, no trigger) so the lens stays put; stacks/HDR lock the metered focus distance as before. Front-camera CameraX video is mirrored when prefs.mirrorSelfies (VideoCapture.Builder.setMirrorMode MIRROR_MODE_ON_FRONT_ONLY; BindingSpec.mirrorVideo, so changing the pref rebinds video).
data_flow_pattern.rotation: UI is portrait-locked. MainActivity's OrientationEventListener -> CameraViewModel.setDeviceRotation -> CaptureEngine.setTargetRotation (Surface.ROTATION_*). CameraXProvider applies it to ImageCapture/VideoCapture; Camera2Provider.outputRotation() uses it for JPEG_ORIENTATION, bitmap rotation, DNG orientation and MediaRecorder hint.
data_flow_pattern.geotagging: MainActivity.observeLocationSetting() starts/stops DeviceLocationProvider while RESUMED and requests location permission when the pref is enabled (denial turns the pref off). Providers receive a `() -> Location?` lambda (null unless locationTagging is on).

core_entry_points.main_activity: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/camera/MainActivity.kt (manual object graph: ImageProcessor, MediaSaver, DeviceLocationProvider, CameraXProvider, Camera2Provider, HybridCaptureEngine, repositories, CameraViewModel; requests CAMERA+RECORD_AUDIO; orientation listener; volume-key shutter; STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA (power double-press while unlocked) opens the normal camera; secure lock-screen camera (showWhenLocked, no image scan, CameraViewModel(secureSession = true) skips the initial MediaStore thumbnail so only this session's captures show; CameraScreen.openOutside routes the thumbnail and 'All settings' through KeyguardManager.requestDismissKeyguard and opens them only after unlocking) only for STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA_SECURE / IMAGE_CAPTURE_SECURE; finishes onStop when secure)

camera_modes.enum: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/camera/domain/model/CameraMode.kt (PHOTO, VIDEO, NIGHT_SIGHT, SLOW_MO, PORTRAIT, PANORAMA, LONG_EXPOSURE, TIME_LAPSE; the old unreachable HDR entry was removed - CameraMode is not persisted)
camera_modes.ui_mode_lists: Single source: CameraModes object in CameraMode.kt. photo = [LONG_EXPOSURE, PORTRAIT, PHOTO, NIGHT_SIGHT, PANORAMA], video = [SLOW_MO, VIDEO, TIME_LAPSE] (Video centered, like Photo in its row); CameraModes.label() (NIGHT_SIGHT shown as "Night"), isVideo(), isCamera2Video(). HDR is not a mode: it is the hdrPhoto preference applied to PHOTO. MainActivity (onModeSwiped, CameraControls, CameraModeSelector) reads CameraModes. When adding a mode: CameraMode + CameraModes lists/label + HybridCaptureEngine/provider routing.

routing.LONG_EXPOSURE: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.captureStack(StackKind.LONG_EXPOSURE): warm-up with longExposureMetering -> planLongExposure -> StackPlan: keeps the metered amount (ns x ISO x boost/100, incl. EV compensation) but puts it into time at base ISO, capped by handheldMaxExposureNs (125ms OIS / 66ms without, / zoom, >= 33ms); remainder -> ISO, post-RAW boost, digitalGain (<= MAX_PLAN_GAIN 4) via splitSensitivity; SENSOR_FRAME_DURATION = max(exposure, getOutputMinFrameDuration(YUV, size)) so frames run back to back; frames = ceil(LONG_EXPOSURE_TARGET_NS 2s / frame duration) clamped 16..32. Burst: AE off, AF locked at metered distance, AWB lock, OIS on, NR MINIMAL/FAST (stackNoiseReduction), edge off. No MANUAL_SENSOR -> AE+AWB lock, 16 frames. NightStacker(longExposure = true): linear-light CV_32FC3 sum + CV_8UC3 per-pixel peak -> longExposureMerge (see feature_map.image_processing) -> MediaSaver (LONG_) -> restore. Lost/failed frames (onCaptureBufferLost, onCaptureFailed without image) are counted and the stack merges without them; captureStack frees the stacker on timeout.
routing.TIME_LAPSE: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.setupTimeLapseRecording: regular session + MediaRecorder (setCaptureRate 2 fps, encoded 30 fps, <=1080p 16:9, stabilization on, applyCommon zoom/EV, torch via Camera2Provider.applyTorch when lightMode == FLASH on the rear camera) writing to pending MediaStore FD; stop shares stopSlowMoVideo(onSuccess, onError) (onError 'Video too short' when MediaRecorder.stop fails); shares prepareRecorder/startRecordingSession/recordingToken with SLOW_MO; live view via the recording preview surface (regular session, same size as the video, 30 fps preview while MediaRecorder keeps 2 fps), with a 'Keep the phone steady' hint (see feature_map.recording_preview).
routing.ROUTING_RULE: Single rule: ModeCapabilities.pipelineFor(mode, isFront, prefs, sceneIsDark, manualExposure) -> CapturePipeline (domain/model/ModeCapabilities.kt). HybridCaptureEngine.capturePhoto calls it (sceneIsDark from wrapping CameraXProvider's low-light listener; manualExposure = its tracked isProMode && ProConfig.hasManualExposure) and, for usesCamera2 pipelines, unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.capture(pipeline) -> restore. CameraUiState.modeCaps calls the same function for the UI; CameraViewModel.performCapture snapshots CameraUiState.capturePipeline for the overlay text/shutter progress. PHOTO on the rear camera, in order: RAW_JPEG -> RAW_STILL; lightMode AUTO_NIGHT_SIGHT && dark && !manualExposure -> NIGHT; hdrPhoto && lightMode not AUTO_FLASH/FLASH -> HDR (flash wins over HDR because only CameraX fires the flash; Camera2Provider.setFlashMode is a no-op); else PHOTO (CameraX). Front-camera PHOTO is always the CameraX PHOTO.
routing.PHOTO_HDR: PHOTO with prefs.hdrPhoto on the rear camera, flash Off or Auto Night, not RAW_JPEG -> Camera2Provider.captureHdr. Auto Night in the dark takes precedence (see ROUTING_RULE).
routing.PHOTO_AUTO_NIGHT: PHOTO with lightMode AUTO_NIGHT_SIGHT ('Auto Night'), rear camera, not RAW_JPEG, no manual ISO/shutter, while the scene monitor reports dark -> CapturePipeline.NIGHT -> Camera2Provider.capture(NIGHT) = captureStack(StackKind.NIGHT) -> restore. ModeCapabilities.autoNightActive drives the shutter moon and accent flash icon.
routing.PHOTO: Default: CameraXProvider.capturePhoto -> captureBinnedPhoto (MP_12 + back camera, GPU binning, saved via MediaSaver) else captureSinglePhoto. Also used for flash shots with HDR on. If saveMode == RAW_JPEG on the back camera: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.capture(RAW_STILL) = captureStill (JPEG bytes + DNG via DngCreator; applyProConfig only while Pro mode is on) -> CameraXProvider.restore().
routing.PORTRAIT: CameraXProvider.capturePortrait -> in-memory capture (captureUprightBitmap, downscaled to <= PORTRAIT_MAX_PIXELS 12.6MP in the rotate pass) -> optional MediaSaver PORTRAIT_ORIGINAL (prefs.portraitKeepOriginal, saved first so the blurred shot is newest) -> ImageProcessor.processPortrait(bitmap, PortraitAperture.blurStrength(prefs.portraitAperture)) -> PortraitSegmenter (FaceLocator.findFaces + NativeVisionBridge.nativePortraitBokeh -> PortraitEngine.cpp) -> MediaSaver (PORTRAIT). While in PORTRAIT, Preview/ImageCapture use CONTROL_SCENE_MODE_FACE_PRIORITY when the camera lists it, and a 640x480 ImageAnalysis feeds PortraitFaceAnalyzer for the live overlay. See feature_map.portrait_segmentation.
routing.PANORAMA: Shutter toggles CameraViewModel.handlePanoramaCapture -> CaptureEngine.startPanorama / stopPanorama (CameraXProvider only; Camera2Provider rejects). ImageAnalysis (RGBA, 4:3, ~1600x1200) -> PanoramaFrameAnalyzer -> PanoramaSession -> native PanoramaEngine. Progress via CaptureEngine.setOnPanoramaProgressListener -> CameraViewModel.panoramaProgress (own StateFlow, cleared on mode/type change and sweep start/stop) -> PanoramaViewfinderGuide + PanoramaStrip (each read inside ReadInOwnScope in MainActivity.kt); hint COMPLETE triggers stopPanoramaCapture. A second sweep is refused while one is still stitching. See feature_map.panorama.
routing.NIGHT_SIGHT: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.capturePhoto -> runCapture -> captureStack(StackKind.NIGHT): warm-up repeating request on an offscreen SurfaceTexture with longExposureMetering (AE target fps range with the lowest lower bound) until AE/AF settle; Meter includes CONTROL_POST_RAW_SENSITIVITY_BOOST. planNight -> StackPlan (frame duration = exposure): target = metered (ns x ISO x boost/100) x NIGHT_CAPTURE_GAIN 1.25; exposure = min(4x metered, handheldMaxExposureNs = 125ms with OIS or 66ms without (HANDHELD_MAX_EXPOSURE_NO_OIS_NS) / max(1, zoom), >= 33ms), shortened if ISO would fall below base; splitSensitivity: ISO, then post-RAW boost (if CONTROL_POST_RAW_SENSITIVITY_BOOST_RANGE exists, always set explicitly), remainder = digitalGain (<= MAX_PLAN_GAIN 4) passed to the merge as its minimum gain; frames 8 / 11 / 14 / 20 by metered ISO-seconds (<50 / >=50 / >=150 / >= NIGHT_VERY_DARK_ISO_SECONDS 400; NIGHT_FRAMES_MIN/DARK/MAX). The burst deliberately stays near viewfinder brightness (a sensor-side push would clip lights for good); all further brightening is measured and applied by nightToneMap (up to 5 EV, see feature_map.image_processing). Burst: AE off, AF locked at metered distance, AWB lock, OIS on when available, NR MINIMAL (else FAST; stackNoiseReduction - HQ NR flattens frames into identical 8-bit steps that band after brightening), edge off (no MANUAL_SENSOR -> AE+AWB lock, 8 frames). NightStacker.finish(rotation, minGain=digitalGain) -> native nightToneMap -> MediaSaver (NIGHT_) -> CameraXProvider.restore()
routing.HDR: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.captureHdr: warm-up, then manual -2/0/+2 EV JPEG bracket (<=8.4MP; AE-compensation fallback) -> ImageProcessor.fuseHdrFrames (native MTB + Mertens) -> rotate -> MediaSaver -> CameraXProvider.restore()
routing.VIDEO: CameraXProvider.startRecording via startSlowMoVideo/stopSlowMoVideo (names are historical); audio enabled when RECORD_AUDIO granted; VideoCapture is built and bound in all video modes (VIDEO/SLOW_MO/TIME_LAPSE) so switching among them never rebinds. QuickTake in PHOTO/PORTRAIT temporarily sets engine mode VIDEO and starts recording in CameraViewModel.onCameraReady(); quickTakeStart sets isRecording immediately (shutter shows stop state during the rebind, timer starts with the real recording) and stopVideo() handles a release while quickTakePending. Chimes: playStartRecordingSound stamps startChimeAt and CameraXProvider.muteDuringStartChime mutes the Recording (Recording.mute) for START_CHIME_MS (800ms) so the mic doesn't record the chime; stopSlowMoVideo mutes before stop() and CameraViewModel plays the stop chime after stopping. MediaActionSound preloads both video chimes.
routing.SLOW_MO: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.startSlowMoVideo (posted to the Camera2 background thread) -> setupHighSpeedRecording: highSpeedConfigs (fixed-rate CONSTRAINED_HIGH_SPEED sizes, cached per camera id) -> SlowMotion.resolveFps(prefs.slowMotionFps, SlowMotion.rates) + SlowMotion.pick (largest 16:9 <= 1080p for that rate) -> prepareRecorder (MediaRecorder to a pending MediaStore FD, SLOMO_, captureRate = fps, encoded at SlowMotion.PLAYBACK_FPS 30, bit rate SlowMotion.bitRate) -> startRecordingSession (SESSION_HIGH_SPEED with the UI's recording preview surface + recorder surface, same size; on config failure retried without the preview) -> setRepeatingBurst(createHighSpeedRequestList) (first request of each burst also feeds the preview; requests carry applyCommon zoom/EV + applyTorch, retried without them if rejected). Stop: CaptureEngine.stopSlowMoVideo posts finishRecording to the background thread (MediaRecorder.stop off the main thread, closes the camera) and HybridCaptureEngine restores CameraX in the callback. recordingToken (bumped by start, stop and abortSlowMo) makes callbacks of a start that was already stopped back out (closing the just-opened camera), so stop-during-open yields 'Video too short' and no background recording. findHighSpeedCamera only picks a camera facing the selected way with usable rates (front without -> 'Slow motion isn't available on the front camera'; CameraViewModel.showSlowMotionHint says so on entering the mode). Speed choice: CaptureEngine.getSlowMotionFrameRates (Camera2Provider caches it per facing in slowMotionRatesCache, since the lookup reads every camera's characteristics; CameraViewModel.onCameraReady queries it on Dispatchers.Default) -> CameraUiState.slowMotionRates -> the Speed tool (ProTool.SPEED -> SlowMotionSpeedControl) of the adjustments row, opened by CameraControls' bottom-right speed pill. Live view: see feature_map.recording_preview.

camera_modes.pro_mode: CameraUiState.isProMode (toggled by the bottom-right Tune button, or the speed pill in Slow motion) opens the adjustments row (see feature_map.pro_controls). The row opens where ModeCapabilities.offersAdjustments (manual-control modes plus Slow motion / Time lapse, which only get exposure compensation and Slow motion's Speed); the engine's pro mode is CameraViewModel.syncEngineProMode = isProMode && supportsManualControls, so ISO/shutter/focus/WB never reach a path that ignores them (enforceModeCapabilities re-syncs on mode changes and closes the row where !offersAdjustments). ProConfig applied live via CameraXProvider.applyProConfigLive (Camera2CameraControl options; AE off when ISO/shutter set, the missing half filled with ProConfig.MANUAL_DEFAULT_ISO 400 / MANUAL_DEFAULT_SHUTTER_NS 1/60 s, manual focus, AWB preset) and Camera2Provider.applyProConfig for RAW + JPEG stills (same defaults; only while Camera2Provider.isProMode, set by setProMode). Where !offersAdjustments (HDR, Night, Long exposure, Panorama) the Tune button is dimmed and CameraViewModel.toggleProMode shows a message ('Turn off HDR to use manual controls' in Photo). Manual ISO/shutter keeps Auto Night from taking over.
camera_modes.per_mode_state: CameraViewModel.resetPerModeState runs on every real mode change (setMode returns early for the current mode; setCaptureType) and camera flip (toggleCamera): exposure compensation back to 0, tap-focus lock released (focus ring, focusAnchor, CaptureEngine.cancelFocus), the manual controls panel closed (ProConfig values kept for when it reopens), palm-timer boxes cleared (clearGestureOverlay, also when prefs.gestureTrigger turns off), and showFrontCameraHint: on the front camera in Photo with hdrPhoto and/or RAW_JPEG set, a status pill "HDR/RAW isn't available on the front camera" once per flip. Panorama always starts at 1x (onModeZoomChanged). The torch follows the mode via enforceModeCapabilities. System Back: CameraScreen's BackHandler is enabled while CameraViewModel.handlesBack (mode != PHOTO and not recording/sweeping/processing) and calls onBack: from the video row -> switchCaptureType(PHOTO, lastPhotoMode) (the photo-row mode last used, tracked in setMode/switchCaptureType); from another photo-row mode -> setMode(PHOTO); in Photo Back leaves the app as before.
camera_modes.scene_analysis: CameraXProvider.attachSceneMonitor: Preview Camera2Interop session capture callback computes ISO*seconds x post-RAW boost/100 every 15 frames with hysteresis (enter 40, exit 20) and requires 2 agreeing evaluations to change -> setOnLowLightListener (PHOTO, rear camera; always attached on the rear camera, independent of prefs, so lowLightSuggestion/lightMode never rebind) -> HybridCaptureEngine.sceneIsDark (Auto Night routing) -> CameraViewModel.onLowLight -> CameraUiState.isLowLight + lowLightSuggested (only if prefs.lowLightSuggestion and lightMode != AUTO_NIGHT_SIGHT) -> SuggestionChips (night chip only, under the top bar; also hidden in the UI while Auto Night is selected). Same hook pins CONTROL_AE_TARGET_FPS_RANGE for VIDEO when prefs.videoFrameRate is supported. QR/barcode scanning: see feature_map.code_scanner. Portrait live faces: see feature_map.portrait_segmentation. FrameAnalysisRouter fans one ImageAnalysis out to GestureAnalyzer / CodeScanAnalyzer / PortraitFaceAnalyzer. The low-light capture callback is attached whenever the pref is on for the rear camera (mode-independent so the Preview can be kept) and only evaluates frames in PHOTO.
camera_modes.binding_and_mode_switching: CameraXProvider records a BindingSpec (PreviewSpec = owner/surfaceProvider/selector/aspect/macro/face-priority/low-light monitor, plus video flag, videoResolution, gesture/codes/portraitFaces/panorama analyzers). rebind() (setMode, applySettings, setGestureTriggerEnabled, restore) is skipped when the spec is unchanged and the camera is bound: it only re-applies live options and posts cameraReady (e.g. VIDEO <-> SLOW_MO <-> TIME_LAPSE, which all bind Preview+ImageCapture+VideoCapture). When only non-Preview parts change (e.g. PHOTO <-> VIDEO) bindUseCases keeps the bound Preview instance, unbinds only the other use cases and binds the new set, so the camera device stays open and the PreviewView surface persists; any failure falls back to unbindAll + full bind (then essentials; a degraded bind clears boundSpec). Video stabilization and the VIDEO fps pin (CONTROL_AE_TARGET_FPS_RANGE) are live Camera2CameraControl options in applyProConfigLive (together with pro-mode and panorama locks), so prefs videoStabilization/videoFrameRate no longer rebind. Zoom ratio is remembered and re-applied after a bind (reset to 1x on camera flip). unbind() clears boundSpec/boundPreview/boundUseCases.
camera_modes.exposure_and_capture_options: CaptureEngine.setExposureCompensation(index) (all three engines; Camera2 applies it in applyCommon so warm-up metering includes it). CameraXProvider.applyFocusOptions adds AF_MODE_MACRO (macroFocus ON, rear) and Portrait FACE_PRIORITY to Preview/ImageCapture at build time; CONTROL_VIDEO_STABILIZATION_MODE is a live option in all video modes (applyProConfigLive). Recorder QualitySelector follows videoResolution (FHD/UHD with fallback). Rebind (subject to the BindingSpec skip, see binding_and_mode_switching) on aspect/videoResolution/macroFocus/scanQrCodes/mirrorSelfies changes (resolution 12MP/MAX is chosen per shot in capturePhoto, no rebind); videoStabilization and videoFrameRate apply live. Torch in video when lightMode == FLASH (CameraViewModel.applyTorch).

main_camera_screen.description: Preview (PreviewView in AndroidView), top bar driven by CameraUiState.modeCaps (ModeCapabilities; see feature_map.mode_capabilities): status glyphs left-aligned with the scan-image button on the right (CameraTopBar): white TextBadge resolution badge ('12/MP' stacked or 'MAX') only when showsResolutionChip, FHD/4K video badge (videoResolutionLabel; tap toggles VideoResolution) only when showsVideoQualitySettings, flash button cycles ModeCapabilities.lightModes via CameraViewModel.cycleFlash/nextLightMode (Photo: Off -> Auto Night -> Auto flash -> On; Portrait without Auto Night; video modes torch Off <-> On; hidden when the list is empty) and shows effectiveLightMode; Auto Night shows a moon icon, accent-tinted when autoNightActive; timer icon (Timer3/Timer10) only where supportsTimer, macro flower icon only where showsMacro; resolution/timer/MACRO chips are disabled while recording (CameraTopBar chipsEnabled), moon badge on the shutter (CameraControls nightShutter, RotatableIcon over ShutterButton, no pointer input) while autoNightActive, tap-to-focus with brightness slider, shutter with long-press QuickTake, zoom presets with live value, centered mode carousel, photo/video toggle, settings button, manual-controls (Tune) button, full-screen processing overlay only when CameraUiState.capturePipeline (snapshot at the shutter press).showsProcessingOverlay (Night/Auto Night, Long exposure, HDR, Portrait; text per pipeline; thumbnail spinner otherwise); screen-flash overlay only when a tap takes a photo right away; while recording the mode row/photo-video toggle/settings button are disabled and dimmed (CameraControls canSwitch), the snapshot button is hidden where !supportsVideoSnapshot, and the zoom row hides in Camera2 recordings (!supportsZoomWhileRecording), timer/panorama/status-message overlays, platform thumbnail opening the last capture, permission screen.
main_camera_screen.shutter: ui/camera/ShutterButton.kt: ShutterButton(style PHOTO/VIDEO/PANORAMA/SLOW_MOTION/TIME_LAPSE (SLOW_MOTION/TIME_LAPSE = 56dp white disc with the SlowMotionVideo/Timelapse glyph on a filled dark circle, red stop square while recording; ShutterStyle.records/hasGlyphDisc), isRecording, isPanoramaCapturing, progress, onCapture, onLongPressStart/End) drawn in one Canvas with a constant 88dp footprint (ShutterSize): dark (#3A3A3C) 7dp ring + 72dp inner disc (white photo, RecordRed video) that springs into a 30dp rounded stop square while recording; panorama sweep = translucent disc + 36dp white square (ring fades); progress (pipelines with CapturePipeline.reportsProgress: Night/Auto Night/HDR incl. Photo HDR/Long exposure; CameraControls showCaptureProgress = isProcessing && CameraUiState.showsCaptureProgress (= capturePipeline?.reportsProgress), value CameraUiState.captureProgress) turns the ring into an arc and dims the disc; press shrinks the inner shape to 0.86 with a bouncy release; photo taps send an expanding ring pulse; haptics on tap/long press; 300ms hold (LONG_PRESS_MS) -> onLongPressStart (QuickTake/hold-to-record; null unless ModeCapabilities.supportsQuickTake, so a hold acts as a tap), canceled gestures do nothing; callbacks read via rememberUpdatedState. RecordingTimerPill (blinking red dot, tabular digits, pause icon + blinking time when paused) is shown by CameraScreen in an AnimatedVisibility at the top center under the top bar while recording (ProControlOverlay shifts down 44dp while recording), so the shutter row never moves. Previews: ShutterButtonPreview, ShutterButtonPanoramaPreview.
main_camera_screen.key_composables: MainActivity.kt: CameraScreen, CameraPreview (viewfinder anchored below TopBarHeight for 4:3/16:9; tap=focus, double-tap=flip, pinch=zoom, horizontal swipe=mode; hosts ExposureSlider; observes PreviewView.previewStreamState: when not STREAMING it holds a quarter-size snapshot (snapshotForTransition) shown blurred over the viewfinder, cross-faded out (280ms) once STREAMING), CameraControls (left thumbnail and right flip buttons are 56dp ControlSquareShape (16dp) rounded squares; below the shutter an AnimatedContent swaps the mode row + bottom row (48dp settings/Tune circles) for the manual-controls ProToolBar (proToolBar slot) while isProMode; left thumbnail <-> pause/resume and right flip <-> snapshot buttons cross-fade; snapshot is a mini ring+disc shutter; uses ShutterButton), CameraModeSelector (AnimatedContent cross-fade when the photo/video row swaps; each row is a ModeCarousel with its own LazyListState and half-width side padding so every mode can sit at the center: snaps to center on first layout, then springs; a custom FlingBehavior projects the release velocity, springs the nearest mode to the center and selects it via onModeSelected; while dragging/settling the white pill and a CLOCK_TICK haptic follow the centered mode, then the pill holds the swiped-to mode (pendingMode) until currentMode catches up, so it never flashes back (1 s fallback if the change is refused); scrolling and taps are disabled when not idle (enabled = idle); selected pill is CameraHighlight (colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer) with OnCameraHighlight text, titleMedium labels, colors animate), PhotoVideoToggle (sliding CameraAccent highlight, 44x40dp segments, selected icon OnCameraAccent), ZoomSwitcher (only the highlighted label carries the 'x': '1x', then '2', '5'; one CameraHighlight pill slides between pills (spring) and heads straight for zoomState.target during a glide; the highlighted pill shows the live zoom, unselected labels scale to 0.9; CLOCK_TICK haptic on tap), ViewfinderZoomControls (overrideContent, when set, replaces everything with the open manual-controls dial; otherwise aboveContent slot (CodeSuggestionChip) + Portrait aperture pill + zoom row, a separate layer in CameraScreen whose bottom sits ZoomControlsGap=16dp above min(viewfinder bottom reported by CameraPreview.onViewfinderBottom, CameraControls top), all in root px; fades/ignores taps during a panorama sweep), RotatableIcon, TimerCountdownOverlay, MediaThumbnail, CameraLayoutPreview (@Preview layout check). ui/camera/PanoramaOverlay.kt (matches Google Camera's panorama UI from user reference screenshots): PanoramaViewfinderGuide, drawn inside the viewfinder via CameraPreview's viewfinderOverlay slot (hollow target circle, short yellow horizon either side, white triangle arrow on the line in the pan direction, white 'next dot' positioned from keyframeDx/targetStep/verticalOffset; circle+dot turn yellow while aligned; idle shows a center dot, arrows on both sides (either direction until the first movement) and the 'Tap shutter and pause briefly on dots' pill; during a sweep only SLOW_DOWN/LOST appear as text; previews: Sweeping/Aligned/Idle), PanoramaStrip (top-corner preview, 112dp tall: live thumbnail before the sweep, then the growing mosaic incl. the live view; right corner for leftward/unknown sweeps, left for rightward), PanoramaShutterGlyph (idle shutter icon). ui/camera/PortraitOverlay.kt: PortraitFaceOverlay (viewfinderOverlay slot in PORTRAIT, hidden while processing) and PortraitApertureControl (ViewfinderZoomControls, above ZoomSwitcher, in PORTRAIT when not recording). While isPanoramaCapturing, CameraControls fades out everything but the shutter (dark disc + white rounded stop square, no ring) and the top bar is hidden; QuickTake long-press is disabled in Panorama. ui/camera/CameraComponents.kt: CameraTopBar (left: TextBadge resolution / video-resolution badges, flash cycle, timer/macro icons; right: optional scan-code-from-image button), TextBadge, CameraHighlight/OnCameraHighlight, ControlSquareShape, SuggestionChips (low-light Night chip under the top bar), CodeSuggestionChip (scanned codes, above the zoom row), ExposureSlider, RotatingIconButton, PermissionRequiredScreen, formatZoom, TopBarHeight (44dp; also the viewfinder's offset below the status bar for cropped ratios), CameraAccent. CameraControls sits on the navigation-bar inset with 20dp under its bottom settings/toggle/Tune row.

code_scanner.description: On-device QR + EAN-13/EAN-8/UPC-A/UPC-E scanning (several codes per frame). Live: in PHOTO with prefs.scanQrCodes, CameraXProvider binds a 1280x720 RGBA ImageAnalysis; FrameAnalysisRouter fans frames to CodeScanAnalyzer (every 4th frame -> toUprightBitmap(1024) -> CodeDecoder.decode -> NativeVisionBridge.nativeDecodeCodes: QRCodeDetectorAruco.detectAndDecodeMulti, classic QRCodeDetector fallback, barcode::BarcodeDetector; returns interleaved raw byte arrays {format, payload} + normalized corners; Kotlin decodes UTF-8 with ISO-8859-1 fallback). Codes stay 'recent' 4s after last seen. Each update is a CodeScanFrame(codes, inView, OutputTransform from ImageProxyTransformFactory (rotation on, crop off, cached per size/rotation), upright frame size) -> CaptureEngine.setOnCodeScanListener (main thread; EMPTY on every rebind; Camera2Provider no-op) -> CameraViewModel.onCodeScanFrame: codeScanFrame StateFlow (only while a code is in view) feeds CodeOutlineOverlay (viewfinderOverlay slot; maps corners with CoordinateTransform(frame transform, PreviewView.outputTransform), PreviewView handed up via CameraPreview.onPreviewViewReady; ~140ms corner glide, fade out); CameraUiState.scannedCodes (minus dismissedCodes, which reset when a code leaves) feeds CodeSuggestionChip (CameraComponents.kt; large white pill with accent icon disc, single code: primary action label + summary; several: 'N codes found'; X dismisses), shown via ViewfinderZoomControls' aboveContent slot so it floats just above the zoom row (thumb reach), in an AnimatedVisibility that keeps the last codes while fading out; hidden while isProMode/recording/codeSheet open; CameraScreen performs HapticFeedbackConstants.CONFIRM when a new code text appears. Tapping the chip -> openScannedCodes -> CameraUiState.codeSheet -> CodeResultSheet. Image: CameraTopBar scan button (PHOTO + scanQrCodes, hidden for the secure lock-screen camera) and the sheet's 'Scan an image' launch PickVisualMedia(ImageOnly) -> CameraViewModel.scanCodesInImage -> CodeDecoder.decodeImage (ImageDecoder software ARGB_8888 <=2048px, tryHarder adds an inverted pass, 1024px retry) -> codeSheet or 'No QR code or barcode found' pill. Parsing: CodePayload.parse (pure Kotlin) -> Url (host, https, user@host warning), Wifi (WIFI: with escapes, OPEN/WEP/WPA/SAE/ENTERPRISE), Contact (MECARD, vCard incl. folding, groups, quoted-printable), Event (VEVENT/VCALENDAR, UTC/TZID/all-day), Email (mailto, MATMSG), Sms (SMSTO, sms:), Phone (tel:), Geo (geo:), Product (EAN/UPC digits; non-QR formats never become links), Text. Actions (CodeActions): Wi-Fi via Settings.ACTION_WIFI_ADD_NETWORKS with a WifiNetworkSuggestion (no permissions; WEP/enterprise/invalid passphrase fall back to copying the password + Wi-Fi panel), ContactsContract.Intents.Insert, CalendarContract ACTION_INSERT, ACTION_SENDTO mailto/smsto, ACTION_DIAL, geo ACTION_VIEW, ACTION_WEB_SEARCH, copy (Wi-Fi password flagged sensitive; toast only < API 33), share chooser; unhandled intents copy the text instead.
code_scanner.rule: The 'scanQrCodes' preference (key scan_qr_codes) gates both live scanning and the top-bar image-scan button. Transform APIs need @androidx.annotation.OptIn(TransformExperimental::class). Keep CodePayload free of Android types so CodePayloadTest runs on the JVM.

hud_overlay.description: Grid (3x3, 4x4, golden ratio), levelers, focus ring, hand/face detection boxes. Levelers are gated by prefs.showLeveler ('Framing hints' / quick-settings 'Leveler') and read LevelState (CameraUiState.kt) in the draw phase (derivedStateOf for visibility, 200ms fade via LevelerFade): HorizonLeveler only while LevelState.isLandscape (orientation 90/270 and the phone not pointing up/down), fixed side marks + a center line parallel to the horizon, snapping and turning accent within 1 degree; TopDownLeveler while LevelState.isFacingDown (camera within 20 degrees of straight down for 1s, hides past 30): fixed center ring (22dp radius) + bubble dot (6dp) offset 4dp/degree toward the raised edge (clamped at 20 degrees), accent + snapped within 1 degree. LevelersPreview renders both.

pro_controls.description: Pro-camera layout (ProControlOverlay.kt). The Tune button toggles CameraViewModel.toggleProMode; while isProMode: ProInfoStrip (translucent band under the top bar, 44dp lower while recording) shows each control as a circled-A 'Auto' or its manual value (accent) and opens that tool on tap; CameraControls swaps the mode row + bottom buttons for ProToolBar (drag handle: tap or drag down closes; Reset All = resetProConfig + setExposureIndex(0); one 56dp button per ProTool, selected = accent circle, set-away-from-auto = accent dot); the selected tool's ProToolControl replaces the zoom row via ViewfinderZoomControls.overrideContent (tapping the open tool again closes its dial). Tools come from availableProTools(capabilities, modeCaps, slowMotionRates): SPEED (Slow motion with high-speed rates: SlowMotionSpeedControl, slowest first, selected = CameraHighlight pill with the slow-motion glyph; not in ProInfoStrip, which hides when only Speed/Exposure are offered), EXPOSURE (wherever ModeCapabilities.offersAdjustments; the only tool besides Speed in Slow motion / Time lapse); ISO/SHUTTER/FOCUS/WHITE_BALANCE only where supportsManualControls. EXPOSURE (exposure compensation, ticks = device EV steps, labelled per whole EV, snaps), ISO + SHUTTER (only when MANUAL_SENSOR; logarithmic 41-tick rulers, circled-A button returns to auto), FOCUS (diopters 0..minFocusDistance, auto button), WHITE_BALANCE (segmented preset pill, mapped to CONTROL_AWB_MODE presets). Rulers (DialRuler): a tick ruler slides under a fixed accent center mark, value bubble above, CLOCK_TICK haptic per tick. The selected tool is UI state in CameraScreen (rememberSaveable selectedProTool). Applied live via Camera2CameraControl.setCaptureRequestOptions in CameraXProvider.applyProConfigLive (no rebind).

mode_capabilities.description: Single source of truth for what the current mode + camera + settings support. ModeCapabilities.forMode(mode, isFront, prefs, sceneIsDark, manualExposure) -> pipeline (CapturePipeline: PHOTO, PORTRAIT, PANORAMA, NIGHT, LONG_EXPOSURE, HDR, RAW_STILL, VIDEO, SLOW_MO, TIME_LAPSE, each with usesCamera2 / reportsProgress / showsProcessingOverlay), lightModes (flash options in cycle order; empty = no flash button: front camera, RAW still, Night, Long exposure, Panorama), flashIsTorch (video modes: Off/On), effectiveLightMode (stored value, or NONE when the mode doesn't offer it, e.g. Auto Night in Portrait), nextLightMode(), autoNightActive, hdrPausedByFlash, showsResolutionChip, showsPhotoOutputSettings (rear Photo: HDR/resolution/file format rows), showsVideoQualitySettings (Video only), showsMacro (rear Photo/Portrait), supportsTimer (photo modes except Panorama), supportsQuickTake (Photo/Portrait/Video), supportsVideoSnapshot (Video), supportsManualControls (CameraX Photo, RAW still, Portrait, Video), offersAdjustments (supportsManualControls pipelines + SLOW_MO + TIME_LAPSE: the adjustments row opens; high-speed sessions need auto 3A so only exposure compensation/speed), supportsSlowMotionSpeed (SLOW_MO), supportsZoomWhileRecording (not Camera2 video). Controls use a static pipeline (sceneIsDark=false) so they don't flicker; only pipeline/autoNightActive follow the live scene. ModeCapabilities.pipelineFor is the engine routing rule (see camera_modes.routing.ROUTING_RULE). Consumers: HybridCaptureEngine.capturePhoto, Camera2Provider.capturePhoto/capture, CameraUiState.modeCaps (autoNightActive, showsCaptureProgress via capturePipeline), CameraViewModel (cycleFlash, applyTorch, enforceModeCapabilities, takePicture timer, quickTakeStart, takePhotoDuringVideo, toggleProMode), MainActivity (top bar, CameraControls, zoom row visibility, processing overlay, SettingsSheet). When adding a mode or a mode-dependent control, extend ModeCapabilities + ModeCapabilitiesTest instead of adding mode checks in the UI.

recording_preview.description: Live view and speed control for Camera2 recordings (Slow motion, Time lapse), which release CameraX so its PreviewView stops. RecordingPreview (ui/camera/SlowMotionControls.kt) is a TextureView composed through CameraPreview's recordingPreview slot (over the PreviewView and the held blur frame, under HudOverlay) whenever the mode isCamera2Video. onSurfaceTextureAvailable -> RecordingPreviewTarget(surfaceTexture, onStreamSize) -> CameraViewModel.setRecordingPreview -> CaptureEngine.setRecordingPreview (Hybrid forwards; CameraXProvider no-op; Camera2Provider stores it @Volatile). At recording start Camera2Provider.attachRecordingPreview sets the texture's default buffer size to the video size, reports the upright size (swapped for 90/270 sensors) and adds Surface(texture) to the session; the view center-crops it with recordingPreviewTransform (undo TextureView's stretch, rotate by -90 x display rotation, uniform fill; the SurfaceTexture transform already rotates/mirrors for the sensor and front camera). The TextureView is transparent until its first frame; it is keyed by a generation that increments whenever the PreviewView reports STREAMING, so after a recording the last frame stays as a freeze frame until CameraX is back, then a fresh TextureView replaces it. onSurfaceTextureDestroyed clears the target only if it is still the current one. No frame after 1.5 s while recording -> dim fallback text ('Recording slow motion' / time lapse); Time lapse shows a 'Keep the phone steady' pill. SlowMotionSpeedControl: segmented pill (slowest first: 1/8x 240 fps, 1/4x 120 fps, per SlowMotion.speedLabel; selected = CameraHighlight with the SlowMotionVideo glyph; just a label with one rate) shown as the Speed tool's control (ProToolControl, in place of the zoom row) while the adjustments row is open in SLOW_MO and CameraUiState.slowMotionRates is non-empty; in SLOW_MO CameraControls replaces the Tune button with SpeedPillButton (glyph + current speed), which opens the row on the Speed tool (tapping it again closes the row) -> CameraViewModel.updateSlowMotionFps -> prefs.slowMotionFps. Preview: SlowMotionSpeedControlPreview.

quick_settings_sheet.description: In-camera bottom sheet (SettingsSheetContent is previewable), always dark (ViewfinderTheme; translucent near-black SheetColor, light scrim), titled '<mode> settings' with an outlined '...' pill that opens SettingsActivity; Slow motion / Time lapse (isVideo && !showsVideoQualitySettings) get a single page without tabs (Flash torch, Grid, Framing hints, Save location, 'records without sound' footnote); elsewhere General/More tabs are two separate boxes (selected = primary pill). Each row (SettingRowWithIcons) = small label, large primary-colored value text, optional caption, and one OptionButton per choice (40dp dark rounded squares, the selected one an animated primary circle; on/off settings are ToggleIconRow icon pairs, not switches; resolution/file-format/video-resolution glyphs are TextBadge, ratio uses RatioGlyph outlines); every row is gated by the ModeCapabilities passed in (modeCaps). General tab: PhotoSettings (flash = modeCaps.lightModes / effectiveLightMode, timer Off/3/10 via TimerMode.selectable when supportsTimer, ratio, macro Off/On when showsMacro) or VideoSettings (1080p/4K, frame rate, stabilization only when showsVideoQualitySettings, else a note that slow motion/time lapse record without sound at up to 1080p; torch when the mode offers it). More tab: showsPhotoOutputSettings = HDR (subtitle when not used: RAW + JPEG or flash on), resolution (12MP/MAX, same labels as the top-bar chip), file format; showsVideoQualitySettings = record audio; always grid (GridMode icon buttons like every other row), framing hints, save location. Setting names match SettingsActivity (HDR, Grid, Framing hints, Stabilization); ResolutionMode/ImageSaveMode/GridMode labels are shared. Previews: PhotoSettingsSheetPreview, MoreSettingsPreview, VideoSettingsSheetPreview.

full_settings.description: SettingsActivity sections: General (save location, sounds, device storage, scan QR codes & barcodes), Composition (framing hints, grid dialog, keep selfies as seen), Fast access (volume key action dialog, double-tap switch, palm timer), Photo (HDR, resolution and file format dialogs (rear camera, Photo mode), low-light suggestions, keep original portraits), Video (resolution, frame rate dialogs, stabilization, record audio), Advanced (timer light), then AppInfoCard (adaptive icon layers ic_launcher_background/foreground clipped to a circle, app name, version via PackageManager, FOSS promise), About (Source code, What's new = CHANGELOG, Report an issue = GitHub issues, all external links; License -> LicenseDialog with the GPL notice + 'Full license' link; Open-source licenses -> OpenSourceLicensesDialog listing ThirdPartyLicenses (keep in sync with README) + Apache 2.0 link) and SupportCard (tertiaryContainer 'Buy me a coffee' link). URLs live in the AppLinks object (SOURCE_CODE https://github.com/fearmikey/Camera, ISSUES, CHANGELOG, LICENSE, APACHE_LICENSE, DONATE https://buymeacoffee.com/ximw7nxi1j); SettingsActions.onOpenUrl -> SettingsActivity.openUrl (ACTION_VIEW + CATEGORY_BROWSABLE, toast if no browser; the app still has no INTERNET permission). Layout: Scaffold + LargeTopAppBar (exitUntilCollapsed, surfaceContainer background); SettingsGroup(title) = SettingsHeader + rounded 24dp surfaceBright card; SettingsItem(icon, title, description, checked, enabled, external, onClick, onCheckedChange) uses Modifier.toggleable(Role.Switch) for switches (Switch onCheckedChange = null, check-mark thumb) and clickable(Role.Button) otherwise, open-in-new icon when external; ChoiceDialog uses selectableGroup/selectable(Role.RadioButton). SettingsList takes contentPadding (Scaffold insets) so the list scrolls behind the navigation bar. SettingsList(prefs, SettingsActions) is previewable (SettingsListPreview, light + dark); SettingsActions.onToggle takes the SettingToggle enum (LOCATION, LEVELER, CAMERA_SOUNDS, MIRROR_SELFIES, TIMER_LIGHT, PALM_TIMER, SCAN_CODES, DOUBLE_TAP, LOW_LIGHT, HDR, PORTRAIT_ORIGINAL, STABILIZATION, AUDIO); onPhotoResolution/onSaveMode/onGridMode/onVolumeKeyAction/onVideoResolution/onVideoFrameRate for the dialogs. Opened from the lock-screen camera only after unlocking.

user_preferences.description: Single UserPreferences data class + enums (UserPreferences.effectiveFlashMode derives flash from LightMode: NONE/AUTO_NIGHT_SIGHT -> OFF, AUTO_FLASH -> AUTO, FLASH -> ON; the Auto Night/HDR/RAW/flash routing rule lives in ModeCapabilities, not here). LightMode persisted names: AUTO_NIGHT_SIGHT meant auto flash up to 1.1.0, so the repository maps a stored AUTO_NIGHT_SIGHT to AUTO_FLASH unless boolean key light_mode_v2 is set (updateLightMode always sets it). Adding a preference requires: field in UserPreferences.kt, key in UserPreferencesRepository.PreferencesKeys, mapping in userPreferencesFlow, an update* function, a CameraViewModel update/toggle method, and UI wiring. Defaults: lightMode NONE (flash off), gestureTrigger false, videoStabilization true, hdrPhoto false, videoFrameRate AUTO, recordAudio true, volumeKeyAction SHUTTER (migrated from legacy volume_key_shutter=false -> VOLUME), scanQrCodes true, doubleTapSwitch true, lowLightSuggestion true, portraitAperture 2.8 (float key portrait_aperture, snapped with PortraitAperture.nearest), portraitKeepOriginal false (portrait_keep_original), slowMotionFps 120 (int key slow_motion_fps; resolved against the camera's rates with SlowMotion.resolveFps, so an unsupported stored value falls back to the closest rate). Enum reads use enumOr() so unknown stored values fall back safely. macroFocus is OFF/ON (default OFF); the old stored AUTO (which behaved like Off) loads as OFF via enumOr. The unimplemented Top Shot, Motion Photo, Lens Selection, Ultra HDR, imageFormat (HEIF), videoCodec, flashMode, showGridLines, saveProSettings and volumeKeyShutter fields were removed (their DataStore keys are simply no longer read; volume_key_shutter is still read once for the volumeKeyAction migration).

capture_engine.description: Engine abstraction and the hybrid router. Tap-to-focus: CameraPreview passes a MeteringPointProvider (typealias in CaptureEngine.kt: normalized x/y + size -> PreviewView.meteringPointFactory.createPoint in view pixels, so crop/rotation are handled) through CameraViewModel.bindToLifecycle to the engines; CameraXProvider.focusAt meters AF+AE+AWB on a TAP_METERING_SIZE (0.1) region with disableAutoCancel; CaptureEngine.cancelFocus (CameraX cancelFocusAndMetering, Camera2 clears its stored tap) is called by the ViewModel when the phone turns away and on mode/camera switches (resetPerModeState). Zoom presets come from ZoomPresets.compute (both providers; CameraXProvider caches per camera id): min ratio if < 0.95, 1x, 2x (rear, maxZoom >= 2), then one stop per telephoto lens found via the logical camera's physicalCameraIds (or other same-facing camera ids), lenses with the same focal length (within 5%) are de-duplicated keeping the largest sensor (Pixels list every lens twice: full sensor + a 2x sensor-crop variant, e.g. Pixel 10 Pro XL physical ids 2,5,4,6,3,9 = main 6.9mm, tele 17.9mm, UW 2.02mm, each also with half the physical size; the tele crop otherwise produced a bogus 10x), 1x = the lens with the largest sensor, magnification = (focal / active sensor diagonal) relative to it, mapped to the largest of 3/4/5/10x it reaches within 15% (Pixel 10 Pro XL tele: 4.5 -> 5x); no digital-only stops. Logs the lens table at INFO (tag ZoomPresets). CameraXProvider handles preview, standard/binned/portrait photos, video (with audio), panorama, palm-timer analysis, sounds, focus, target rotation, camera-ready callback, restore(). Camera2Provider handles Night/Long exposure/HDR bursts, RAW+JPEG stills (Camera2Provider.capture(CapturePipeline)), slow-mo high-speed and time-lapse video (all recording state on its background thread; CaptureEngine.setRecordingPreview gives them a live view, CaptureEngine.getSlowMotionFrameRates lists the speed choices; HybridCaptureEngine restores CameraX only in the stop callbacks); opens the device on demand and guarantees a single completion callback (CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS 30s). Its zoom resets to 1x when bindToLifecycle gets a different camera selector. CaptureEngine.stopSlowMoVideo(onSuccess, onError) reports exactly one outcome (CameraX: Finalize errors go to the stop's onError, 'Video too short' for ERROR_NO_VALID_DATA; Camera2: MediaRecorder.stop failure); CameraViewModel.stopVideo shows the message and ends QuickTake. HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX before any Camera2 operation and calls CameraXProvider.restore() afterwards; delivers callbacks on the main thread. Capture progress: CaptureEngine.setOnCaptureProgressListener (CameraXProvider no-op; Camera2Provider.reportProgress from its background thread, posted to main by HybridCaptureEngine): metering done 0.08, frames received up to 0.85 (stack) / 0.45 (HDR, fusion is slow), merged 0.95, saved 1.0 -> CameraViewModel (accepted only while isProcessing and increasing; reset to 0 at capture start/end) -> CameraUiState.captureProgress -> ShutterButton ring + determinate full-screen overlay spinner.
capture_engine.rule: New engine capabilities must be added to the CaptureEngine interface and implemented in HybridCaptureEngine, CameraXProvider, and Camera2Provider.

image_processing.description: ImageProcessor is the facade (shader loading, pixel binning, createNightStacker, fuseHdrFrames, processPortrait). GpuImageProcessor owns the EGL context and binning programs (never release() it while ImageProcessor is in use). NightStacker(width, height, longExposure) streams YUV frames into the native accumulator: Night = CV_16UC3 sum of 8-bit frames; Long exposure = CV_32FC3 linear-light sum (srgb8ToLinear LUT) + CV_8UC3 per-pixel peak (NightStacker::accumulate). Alignment: MTB translation at 1/4 scale, refined to sub-pixel by phaseCorrelate on up to 3 512px full-res luma patches (setReference: strongest Laplacian-energy center per 3x3 grid cell, strongest cells first, >= 25% of the best, non-overlapping; refinePatch checks coarse/+pc/-pc against each patch; refineShift takes the per-axis median, so one patch on moving water/traffic is outvoted), warpAffine INTER_CUBIC. nativeNightFinish(ptr, out, rotation, minGain) picks the merge from the stacker mode. Night -> nightToneMap in vision_jni.cpp (night-mode look: bright, contrasty, true blacks; all 16-bit until the end). Stats on an area-averaged 1/8 copy in linear light: per-channel black point = 0.5th percentile, capped at min(kNightMaxBlack 0.02, kNightBlackShare 0.6 x that channel's log-average) and faded out when the scene needs no brightening; log-average and 90th-percentile luminance above black. gain = clamp(max(min(kNightKey 0.14 / log-average, kNightHighTarget 0.8 / p90), minGain), 1, kNightMaxGain 32). Per pixel: per-channel float LUT indexed by the exact frame sum (sRGB linearize, subtract black, x gain) -> one factor from the largest channel = extended Reinhard shoulder (white = gain) x S-curve (two power segments in sRGB space meeting at kNightPivot 0.40 with slope 1 + 0.35 x look, as a 65536-entry factor LUT), so hue/saturation are kept -> 65536-entry linear->16-bit sRGB LUT. look = clamp(log2(gain) / kNightFullLookStops 2, 0, 1) also scales saturation (to kNightSaturation 1.15); gain 1 = identity. Then finishRgb16(FinishParams: chroma median at 1/2 resolution, 1/4 from gain >= kNightStrongChromaGain 16; saturation; sharpen amount 0.8 / (1 + 0.25 x stops), coring ~2 levels x (1 + 0.5 x stops)). Long exposure -> longExposureMerge: linear mean; light-trail recovery blends toward the peak with w = smoothstep(0.90, 0.99, max peak channel sRGB) x smoothstep(0.10, 0.35, linear peak - mean) x (1 - smoothstep(0.08, 0.30, linear mean)) (only clipped, moving, emissive highlights in dark surroundings); x minGain (clamped 1..4) with extended Reinhard (white = gain); 65536-entry linear->16-bit sRGB LUT; finishRgb16(chroma denoise only if gain > 2, amount 0.6). finishRgb16(rgb16, FinishParams, out) (shared; FinishParams = chromaDenoiseScale 0/2/4, saturation, sharpenAmount, sharpenCoring): YCrCb, optional chroma median 5 at 1/scale resolution, optional chroma scale around 32768, cored unsharp mask on Y (sigma 1.2, coring ~2 levels by default), triangular dither to 8 bits. No CLAHE (it banded smooth dark walls).

portrait_segmentation.description: Portrait mode, no ML runtime. Capture: FaceLocator.findFaces (android.media.FaceDetector at 480px, up to 5 faces, drops faces < 45% of the largest's eye distance, largest first) -> NativeVisionBridge.nativePortraitBokeh(bitmap, faceBoxes FloatArray {l,t,r,b}*n normalized, strength) -> vision_jni.cpp wrapper -> portrait::renderBokeh in PortraitEngine.cpp (in place on CV_8UC4): (1) GrabCut at 640px long side seeded per face with two Silhouette priors (kCore/kReach: head ellipse + body outline to the frame bottom, in head-box units): a tight core as PR_FGD (GrabCut grows it into matching colors) and a wide reach as PR_BGD whose shoulder edge slopes down from the jaw, everything outside every reach = BGD (removes chair backs/shelves poking up behind the shoulders); inner face + chest strip = FGD (no face -> centered GC_INIT_WITH_RECT). Keep the core tight: GrabCut mostly keeps regions in their starting class, so background inside a generous prior stays sharp as blocks stuck to the head/shoulders. Then resolveBody (below the chin, inside the reach): GrabCut's GMMs are read back (ColorModel, OpenCV's 5-component model layout) for a clipped per-pixel log likelihood ratio, box-averaged at two scales (face width/10 and /30); where both are weak (|mean| < kDecisive = 3, e.g. a black shirt on a dark wall, where GrabCut's smoothness cuts the shoulders off vertically) the log-odds become evidence + the kShoulders typical-shoulder prior (signed distance, full strength 0.4 face widths from its outline) + the mirror image of the other shoulder when that one is clearly subject; Gaussian-smoothed (face width/12) and thresholded; only ADDS subject (never removes what GrabCut kept). Then refineHeads: a second GrabCut per head crop with its own color models (skin + hair vs the background around the head, not the clothes), which replaces the global result above the chin out to the head reach and is OR-ed with it inside kHeadTrust (core + margin for temple hair and ears, where dark hair can match a dark background); (2) open/close, keep components touching a face (or center seed), fill enclosed holes < 0.4% of the frame, Gaussian + threshold to smooth the outline; (3) fast color guided filter: coefficients at 640px, applied with a 1280px guide, used only inside a band of 1.4% of the matte long side around the outline (smoothstep taper to the anti-aliased binary mask; output remapped 0.2..0.8 -> 0..1) and only where its color model explains the mask (local R^2 ramp 0.35..0.75, else the mask; e.g. dark hair on a dark shelf) so the soft edge has an even width and no half-sharp background patches -> 8-bit matte; (4) lens blur at 1024px: sRGB->linear (gamma 2.2), highlight boost (luma > 0.7 linear, gain 8), anti-aliased disc kernel radius = 1.8% of the long side x strength, normalized convolution weighted by (1-alpha)^2 so the subject never bleeds; (5) Immerkaer/median luma-noise estimate on a full-res center crop, re-applied as tiled 512px grain to the background; (6) full-res 8-bit blend. Strength = PortraitAperture.blurStrength(f) = 2.8/f (f/1.4..f/16 stops), clamped natively to [0.1, 2.5]. Live UI: PortraitFaceAnalyzer (every 3rd analysis frame -> toUprightBitmap(480) -> FaceLocator.findFaces) -> PortraitFaceFrame(faces, OutputTransform, frame size) -> CaptureEngine.setOnPortraitFacesListener (main thread; EMPTY on every rebind; Camera2Provider no-op) -> CameraViewModel.portraitFaces -> PortraitFaceOverlay (maps boxes with CoordinateTransform via the shared TransformCache from CodeOutlineOverlay.kt; accent brackets on the main face, white on others, 160ms glide; hints 'No face found · blur centers on the subject' after 1.5s without faces, 'Move closer for a stronger effect' when the main face is < 10% of the frame width). PortraitApertureControl: 'ƒ/2.8' pill that expands to a Slider (right = more blur), auto-collapses after 4s, writes CameraViewModel.updatePortraitAperture.
portrait_segmentation.rule: Keep PortraitEngine.cpp free of JNI/Android headers (OpenCV core + imgproc only) so it can be compiled and checked on a desktop host; logging happens in the vision_jni.cpp wrapper. GestureAnalyzer still uses FaceLocator.findLargestFace.

panorama.description: Sweep panorama driven entirely by image tracking (no sensor dots). Capture: CameraXProvider binds a 4:3 RGBA ImageAnalysis (target 1600x1200) in PANORAMA; startPanorama creates a PanoramaSession (tan(FOV/2) from LENS_INFO_AVAILABLE_FOCAL_LENGTHS + SENSOR_INFO_PHYSICAL_SIZE / zoom) and locks AE/AWB via applyProConfigLive. PanoramaFrameAnalyzer feeds every frame synchronously to the native PanoramaEngine: frame projected to a cylinder at ~300px width, tracked against the last keyframe (ORB + 1-point translation RANSAC, phaseCorrelate fallback), 'pause on dots' keyframing: the next dot sits 33% of the width past the last keyframe on the starting horizon, and a keyframe is taken only when the dot is inside the target circle (4.5% of width) and the camera has been paused (smoothed speed < 0.12 widths/s, from ImageProxy timestamps passed to nativeProcessFrame) for 400 ms. There is no forced capture: panning past a dot captures nothing, the UI arrow flips back toward the dot and a 'Go back to the dot' pill appears; the native preview strip also draws the live view (PanoramaSession double-buffers it at ~15 Hz); before a sweep PanoramaFrameAnalyzer emits an idle live thumbnail (NativePanoramaBridge.nativeThumbnail, ~8 Hz) as PanoramaProgress(isIdlePreview = true); live focal self-calibration (homography-cleaned planar matches vs keyframe 0, 1-D cylinder-translation fit) rebuilds the tracking cylinder if lens metadata is wrong. Status/hints (START, KEEP_GOING, SLOW_DOWN, TILT_UP/DOWN, LOST, COMPLETE) + a 360-degree preview strip reach the UI as PanoramaProgress (~15 Hz). COMPLETE (360 degrees or 48 keyframes) auto-stops. Stitch (stopPanorama detaches the session on the analysis executor, then Dispatchers.Default): focal re-fit over all pairs, full-res cylindrical warp, pairwise ORB refinement at half res, vertical drift leveling, per-seam gain match, DP min-cost seam + local Laplacian multi-band blend, crop to largest covered rectangle -> exact-size Bitmap -> MediaSaver (PANO_). Fewer than 2 keyframes -> PanoramaTooShortException ('Pan further...'). Host-verifiable: PanoramaEngine.cpp only needs OpenCV core/imgproc/features2d/calib3d + android/log.h.
panorama.rule: JNI names are bound to com.fearmikey.camera.data.engine.processing.NativePanoramaBridge (panorama_jni.cpp) and com.fearmikey.camera.data.engine.processing.NativeVisionBridge (vision_jni.cpp); renaming/moving those classes requires updating the C++ symbol names. Do not use cv::detail stitching classes (not exported by the Maven OpenCV .so).

gesture_palm_timer.description: CameraX ImageAnalysis (RGBA; 1280x960 for the palm timer, 1280x720 when QR scanning is also on) bound when gestureTrigger is enabled (not in PANORAMA or video). GestureAnalyzer works in the world-upright frame: rotation = imageInfo.rotationDegrees + deviceRotation(), where CameraXProvider.gestureDeviceRotation derives the extra turn from targetRotation (OrientationEventListener) and lens facing (back -surface degrees, front +surface degrees, the CameraX relation), so it works with the phone held sideways although the UI is portrait-locked; boxes are mapped back to the portrait viewfinder frame (toDisplay) for the HUD, and the face track resets when the rotation changes. Only crops are rotated/scaled (cropUpright), never the whole frame. Every 3rd frame: face search = tracked window around the last face (TRACK_MAX_SIDE 480) else whole frame at 480 px plus, every other frame while none is found, at 960 px (FaceLocator.findFaces(maxSide), for people a few meters away). Palm search on a crop around the face (+/-4 face widths, 2.5 face heights above/below) at full analysis resolution, scaled so the face is ~110 px wide (PALM_MAX_SIDE 640) -> NativeVisionBridge.nativeDetectOpenPalm (face-calibrated YCrCb skin mask sampled from the cheeks/nose band of the face box, Cr/Cb tolerance >= 11; face/neck of the main face and of every other detected face (otherFaces arg) removed; open/close kernels face width/36 and /20; skin blobs taller than 1.5x the face box cropped to their top part so a bare forearm/shoulder merged with the hand still qualifies; area 0.3-3.5x face, aspect 0.6-2.6; then scored: >= 3 deep finger valleys (depth >= 0.15 h, angle <= 90 deg) = spread hand anywhere; otherwise only when 'posed' (center at head height: face.top - 1.6 fh .. face.top + 1.3 fh, not touching the crop edge, solidity <= 0.97): >= 1 valley (depth >= 0.07 h, angle <= 108 deg, valley below tips) with solidity >= 0.7 and aspect >= 1 = relaxed open hand, or no valley with solidity >= 0.85, aspect 1.25-2.4, area 0.45-2.5x face = fingers together). 3 consecutive hits trigger; 8s cooldown. ViewModel.setupGestureTrigger smooths boxes into GestureOverlayState for the HUD; on a trigger (Photo capture type, mode supportsTimer, not recording/processing) it shows isTimerPending for 1s then starts a 3s timer. The 600ms hand-box clear job only hides the overlay; it must not cancel the pending trigger (it used to, so lowering the hand during the 1s lock-on silently dropped the timer).

sensors_and_orientation.description: CameraViewModel uses GAME_ROTATION_VECTOR (fallback ROTATION_VECTOR, then ACCELEROMETER). Gravity 'up' in device axes (rotation-matrix row 3, or raw accelerometer) is low-passed as a vector, then gives roll = atan2(-x, y) (+ when turned clockwise) and screen elevation asin(z) (+90 = camera facing down). orientationState (icon rotation: 0/90/180/270) updates with 55-degree hysteresis and only while |elevation| < 60. LevelState feeds the HUD levelers. The camera direction (rotation-matrix column 3; accelerometer: up) is stored as focusAnchor on each tap; turning more than 10 degrees away calls CaptureEngine.cancelFocus and clears the focus ring. Panorama does not use sensors (image tracking). Capture rotation comes from MainActivity's OrientationEventListener (see data_flow_pattern.rotation).

media_thumbnail.description: MediaRepository queries the newest image/video in MediaStore (off the main thread); MediaThumbnail renders it with ContentResolver.loadThumbnail; tapping opens ACTION_VIEW on that URI with its MIME type and read-grant.

media_saving_and_location.description: MediaSaver writes processed JPEGs (pending insert, EXIF date/make/model/GPS) and builds MediaStore ContentValues for CameraX photo/video outputs. DeviceLocationProvider wraps the framework LocationManager (fused/gps/network) while resumed.

known_gaps_and_stubs: UI performance pass (zoomState/panoramaProgress split out of CameraUiState, stable callbacks in CameraScreen, draw-phase rotation/alpha/scale for icons, top bar, controls fades, zoom row and timer countdown, cached CameraXProvider.supportsFps) is build/unit/preview-verified only, not profiled or device-tested. No app-specific Baseline Profile yet (library profiles are installed via the transitive androidx.profileinstaller); adding one needs a macrobenchmark module and a device.

Mode-consistency pass (ModeCapabilities gating, capture/sweep/recording guards, Pro mode off for Camera2 stills, Camera2 zoom reset on camera flip, flash-over-HDR routing, HDR EV fallback, stop-recording errors, same-facing slow motion, torch in Camera2 recordings incl. the high-speed retry without zoom/torch) is unit/build/preview-verified only, not device-tested.

Per-mode state reset (CameraViewModel.resetPerModeState: brightness, tap-focus lock, manual controls panel, palm-timer boxes, front-camera HDR/RAW hint, Panorama starting at 1x), the settings cleanup (removed preferences, Macro Off/On migration, matching labels, grid icon row, photo resolution/file format in SettingsActivity, typed SettingToggle keys) and the lock-screen unlock prompt + session-only thumbnail are unit/build/preview-verified only, not device-tested.

Viewfinder framing (data_flow_pattern.framing: Camera2 aspect/size picking and crops, Full-ratio crop for CameraX photos, Camera2 tap-to-focus regions + AF trigger, mirrored front Night/Long exposure and front video) is unit/build-verified only, not device-tested; check the tap mapping on a front camera and in 16:9 and Full. Video is not cropped to the Full viewfinder (records 16:9/4:3), Camera2 Time lapse is never mirrored, and the DNG of RAW + JPEG keeps the full sensor. Camera2 stills keep fixed sizes regardless of the 12MP/MAX setting (Night/Auto Night <= 12.6MP, HDR <= 8.4MP, RAW + JPEG full sensor); the 12MP/MAX chip is hidden where those pipelines are static (ModeCapabilities.showsResolutionChip), but Auto Night in Photo still overrides MAX.
No DI framework: object graph is built in MainActivity.onCreate; CameraViewModel is constructed directly (not via ViewModelProvider), so it does not survive configuration changes.

Slow motion / Time lapse live view (TextureView recording preview, preview-surface fallback, freeze frame until CameraX streams), the 1/4x-1/8x speed choice, background-thread start/stop with recordingToken cancellation and the timer starting on the real recording start are build/unit-verified only, not device-tested. Check on a device: the TextureView crop/orientation (incl. front camera and natural-landscape tablets), that devices accept preview + recorder in the high-speed session at the video size, and 240 fps encoding. Recording still starts ~0.5-1 s after the tap (CameraX is released and Camera2 opens the camera), and after stopping CameraXProvider.restore does a full CameraX bind on the main thread (logged as 'bindUseCases: N ms'; reusing the unbound use cases or keeping VideoCapture out of the Slow motion/Time lapse binding are the next options if it is still a visible hitch); zoom is fixed for the whole Camera2 recording and tap-to-focus does not apply.

New modes/features (Long exposure, Time lapse, code scanner incl. barcodes/outline/image scan/Wi-Fi join, low-light chip, fps pinning, volume zoom) are build- and preview-verified only, not device-tested. Code scanning runs only on the CameraX analysis stream (Camera2Provider.setOnCodeScanListener is a no-op). OpenCV's barcode detector covers EAN/UPC only (no Code 128/39, Data Matrix, PDF417).
Video snapshot is unavailable during slow-motion and time-lapse recording (the snapshot button is hidden there).

Portrait rebuild (lens bokeh, guided-filter matte, multi-face, live face overlay, aperture control, face-priority 3A, keep original) is build/preview-verified and the native pipeline was host-tested on a synthetic 12MP scene with a ground-truth mask (~0.5s on desktop; matte IoU 0.98, ~0.9% of the background left sharp), but only lightly device-tested (user reported uneven blur around head/shoulders with a dark chair and shelves behind dark hair and a black shirt; addressed by the core/reach prior, per-head GrabCut and confidence-gated band matte, checked on that photo with a host harness; a second report showed black-shirt shoulders cut off along straight vertical lines against dark walls, addressed by resolveBody and checked on the already-processed photos only; re-check on device). In color-ambiguous areas the shoulder outline is a template guess (kShoulders) and may keep a little dark background beside the shoulders or miss unusually wide/sloped ones. Segmentation is still color-based GrabCut with no depth: background objects touching the subject in a similar color can stay sharp (e.g. a black chair corner touching dark hair, dark objects right beside a black shirt's shoulder), results depend on FaceLocator's box being accurate, and there is no depth-graded blur. android.media.FaceDetector finds frontal faces only (profiles fall back to the centered prior).
Not implemented (preferences removed in the settings cleanup; re-add with the feature): Top Shot, Motion Photo, Lens Selection, Ultra HDR, HEIF output, video codec choice.
White balance uses AWB presets, not true Kelvin control.

Mode-switch fast paths (BindingSpec skip, preview-kept rebind for Photo <-> Video, live stabilization/fps options) and the viewfinder blur cross-fade are build-verified only, not device-tested. If a device rejects Preview + ImageCapture + VideoCapture with the Preview's existing stream spec, it falls back to the old full rebind.
Layout verified only via @Preview renders (CameraLayoutPreview, sheet and panel previews), not yet on a physical device.

Lens-based zoom presets (.5/1x/2x/5x) and the floating zoom row are device-verified on a Pixel 10 Pro XL. Landscape-only horizon leveler, top-down leveler and the tap-focus coordinate fix + hold-until-moved are build/preview-verified only. If a device hides its physical camera ids, no telephoto stop is shown (pinch still reaches it). Portrait's zoom policy (rear 2x default, 1x/2x, 1-3x; front .7x/1x labels via ZoomPresets.labelScale) is unit-tested and build-verified only; the selfie label scale is derived from focal length/sensor size and assumes Google Camera's 24mm '1x', not read from the device.

Palm timer requires a visible face (android.media.FaceDetector: upright, roughly frontal faces; range limited by the 1280-px analysis stream) and relies on a skin-color model; less robust than an ML hand tracker. The landscape/distance support (device-rotation-aware analysis, 960-px far pass, face-scaled palm crops) and the detector changes are build-verified only, not device-tested.
Universal APK is large (~200MB debug) because OpenCV ships 4 ABIs; use -PabiFilter for per-ABI builds.
Night/Long exposure/HDR process at <=12.6MP / <=12.6MP / <=8.4MP; HDR Mertens fusion is memory-heavy, and the Long exposure merge holds ~190MB native (float linear sum + peak) at 12.6MP.

Long exposure rebuild (base-ISO back-to-back plan, 16-32 frames, linear-light merge, light-trail recovery, multi-patch median alignment, lost-frame tolerance) is build-verified only, not device-tested; trail-recovery thresholds may need tuning on real scenes. Frames are processed as they arrive with a 3-buffer ImageReader, so when per-frame processing (~100-200ms at 12MP) is slower than the frame duration the sensor stalls and the burst spreads out with gaps (check the 'burst span' log). In bright light per-frame exposure is necessarily short (no ND filter), so fast motion shows as stepped copies rather than a continuous smear; frame interpolation is not implemented.

Night rebuild (boost-aware manual exposure, long-exposure metering, 8-20 frame plan, linear-light tone map) and Auto Night are build-verified only, not device-tested. The 1.2.3 night-look tone map (user report: Night shots stayed dark next to Pixel Night Sight) was tuned on a host harness only: the real nightToneMap compiled against desktop OpenCV with stub JNI headers and fed simulated 8-bit bursts (street with lamps, dim room, AE-limited room, lit room; mean output level 69/86/32/107 before -> 101/107/70/110 after, lit room unchanged); its constants (kNightKey 0.14, kNightHighTarget 0.8, kNightMaxGain 32, kNightContrast 1.35, black-point caps) still need checking on real scenes. Watch the 'Night tone map: logAvg ... -> gain' log line (VisionNDK). Known limits: the per-channel black point assumes the darkest 0.5% of the frame is neutral, so a scene whose darkest area is tinted (deep blue sky) shifts slightly toward the complement; at gains near 32 the picture is grainy (only chroma is denoised, no luma denoise); frames are not pushed on the sensor and per-frame exposure stays <= 1/8 s, so a very dark scene collects ~2.5 s of light where Night Sight collects up to ~6 s; no local tone mapping (one global curve). Night still merges ISP-processed 8-bit YUV (no RAW merge) with global translation-only alignment (sub-pixel since the banding/sharpness fix, multi-patch median since the Long exposure rebuild, also build-verified only), so moving subjects and handheld roll can ghost or soften; NR MINIMAL frames may show more grain than before. Shutter/overlay capture progress is build-verified only.

Panorama: portrait-held horizontal sweeps only; output height = analysis stream long side (~1600px, 1280 on the emulator); keyframes are kept in native memory (~5.8MB each, max 48). Translation-only model, so strong camera roll or close parallax can ghost (seams usually hide it). Not yet tested on a physical device; the emulator virtual scene cannot be panned from adb, so stitching was verified with a host harness (synthetic pinhole sweeps with drift/noise and wrong lens metadata) plus on-emulator start/stop/HUD and one mouse-panned sweep.
A stray .artifacts/ directory exists under app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/camera/ (git-ignored planning docs, not code).
